beers.name: Best Day Oktoberfest
beers.description_excerpt: Experience the essence of Bavaria with Best Day Oktoberfest, an Amber Festbier that captures the spirit of the traditional Oktoberfest celebrated in Munich. This limited-time offering is crafted in the style of a classic Märzen, making it a perfect choice for those looking to savor seasonal flavors. The beer enchants with its warm amber glow, offering a delightful aroma of malty richness. beers.name: 1820 Brewing Stand Up & Stout
beers.description_excerpt: Stand Up & Stout from 1820 Brewing offers a compelling non-alcoholic take on the traditional stout. Medium-bodied and dark in appearance, this brew balances a mild sweetness with a smooth roasted malt finish, delivering a nuanced flavor that’s rich without overwhelming the palate. Its complexity is rooted in a thoughtful blend of ingredients, including malted barley, roasted barley, malted wheat, and rolled oats. The hop profile features a classic trio—Nugget, East Kent Golding, and Fuggles—adding earthy and lightly bitter notes that round out the stout's character. With just 80 calories

beers.name: Ceebo Mexican Style Amber with Lime
beers.description_excerpt: Ceebo's "The Amber" is a delightful non-alcoholic amber cerveza infused with a refreshing hint of lime. This versatile brew showcases rich dark roasted malt and toffee notes, perfectly balanced by the zesty lime, making it an ideal choice for those seeking a session-friendly darker style. Whether paired with tacos, enjoyed at a BBQ, or sipped while relaxing by the beach, "The Amber" promises to elevate any occasion. Indulge in a flavorful experience that brings the best of ambers without the alcohol.

beers.name: Go Brewing F*k'in Pum'kin
beers.description_excerpt: Go Brewing introduces F*k'in Pum'kin*, a bold seasonal release available exclusively to its Beer Club members. Crafted as a special thank-you to loyal fans, this non-alcoholic brew skips the gimmicks and goes straight for what matters—rich, fresh flavor. Brewed with real pumpkin purée and a warming blend of fall spices including cinnamon, nutmeg, clove, allspice, and ginger, it's designed to capture the essence of autumn in every sip.
